hazards.description: Trash bins placed on the sidewalk narrow the effective walking width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk in front of the modern grey building

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Access
hazards.description: A wide curb cut for a gas station creates a large conflict zone between vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane, increasing the risk of collisions during informal crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where vehicles are parked.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas on this residential street may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing maneuvers.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway area between the sidewalks.

hazards.name: Excessive Curb Cut Width
hazards.description: The driveway for the gas station and parking area is extremely wide, creating a long stretch where pedestrians have no physical protection from turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground, spanning the width of the parking area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Discontinuity
hazards.description: The paved sidewalk terminates at the edge of the residential property, forcing pedestrians to walk through an active vehicle maneuvering area.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition point between the brick building and the open parking lot

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple travel lanes and a bike lane, increasing their time of exposure to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island means pedestrians have no safe place to wait if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical buffer or parked cars to protect pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground.

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway with multiple lanes and no visible traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway area.

hazards.name: Large Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large PODS storage container blocks sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting the gas station.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left

hazards.name: Excessive Driveway Width
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a massive, undefined paved area where pedestrians have no protected space and long exposure to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no designated, raised walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the vehicle travel area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential and institutional corridor.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for visitors to the church.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical bollards or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical protection and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to clearly designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations against obstructing the public right-of-way with trailers or oversized vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and repair cracked concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage if there is significant pedestrian demand between intersections.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or other vertical deflection measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the ends of the block or near access points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Formalized Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Designate a specific area for trash bins and street furniture to ensure the clear walking path remains unobstructed.

interventions.title: Clear Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Remove the large container and ensure the walkway remains clear for pedestrian use.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a clear, designated path for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the driveway at a consistent grade and with consistent materials to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, using curbs or planters to define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting to improve visibility of pedestrians in the large conflict zone, especially near the commercial entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with benches or planters to create a physical and psychological barrier between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high due to the bus stop, install a high-visibility marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk across the gas station frontage to provide a dedicated and protected space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove large storage containers or other temporary structures from the public right-of-way to restore sightlines.
